rubrics.justification: The response overstates image-resolvable detail. The image is blurred and does not clearly support confident claims of a tightly packed A-grade ICM, cohesive A-grade TE, or definite zona thinning; it largely leans on the provided Gardner score rather than visible morphology.

It integrates age, ovarian reserve, prior live birth, sperm parameters, endometrium, BMI, and lifestyle well with prognosis, though some links are speculative and not all factors materially alter embryo-level assessment.

The structure is logical, but the probability framework is somewhat ad hoc, with unsupported numeric modifiers and optimistic euploidy assumptions. Some concerns raised (e.g., ERA, thrombophilia) are not well justified for this favorable case.

Much is broadly consistent with IVF practice, but several recommendations are not strongly guideline-based for this scenario, including routine consideration of ERA, thrombophilia workup, low-dose aspirin, and PGT-A in a 27-year-old with good prognosis.

Provides practical transfer and future-cycle suggestions, including fresh vs freeze-all considerations and luteal support options, but some steps are overly broad or not clearly indicated in this low-risk case.
